title: Steam account data and game saves
whyItMatters: Steam keeps one folder per account that has signed in, with save games, screenshots, chat history and the cached credentials that keep the account logged in.
source: Arch Wiki, Steam: the default install is ~/.local/share/Steam and userdata holds per-account saves: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Steam
notes: Each numeric folder is a Steam account id with per-game saves and screenshots inside. Account names and SteamIDs are in config/loginusers.vdf, which this rule does not count. ~/.steam/steam is normally a symlink to this tree. The Flatpak uses ~/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam/userdata.

cleanup.signOut: In Steam, click your profile name in the upper-right corner and select Sign out of account.
steps: Launch Steam and sign out of your account to clear saved login credentials.
Delete the folder named in the plan using your file manager.
cleanup.risk: Removes local Steam user profiles, offline save games, screenshots, and custom configurations.
